root_cause: createPortalDomainState tracked pending BusinessInput bindings and causal impacts only in transient Map/Array memory. The canonical customer state had been saved but after a browser reload no semantic Brain handoff generation or 50+ impacts could be recovered; the next login could show source truth without downstream acknowledgement.
fix: Persist only pending semantic binding and all causal-impact lineage under portal.__brainHandoffJournalV1 using the original authenticated Portal State writer before downstream section calls; on authenticated init hydrate the exact user+server-tenant principal's obligations, validate binding and impacted source paths, and reuse original flush. Persist partial-ACK removal in same server state, never auto-save newer unsaved typing, preserve other principals, and exclude outbox metadata from AI-eligible PortalDomainStateSnapshot.
prevention_rules: Before the first section-level Brain handoff, persist the exact pending binding manifest and all causal impact generations to the existing tenant-guarded Portal server state.
After original Brain ACK remove only the acknowledged binding generations; persist the remaining manifest, including on partial failure.
Restore and validate only the exact authenticated principal and app_metadata tenant; never relay an older user or tenant source under current credentials.
Never treat pending server-state journal, a derived readback or source test as executed action, verified outcome, measured impact or learned decision.
owner: Original Portal V2 runtime / ONE BRAIN issue #4215
limitations: Cannot preserve unsaved data never accepted by the server; cross-device concurrent writes and full server-side autonomic processing when no authenticated browser session remain EVIDENCE_DUE.
